name: Installer runs and can be rerun without consuming IDs or altering ledger
Reserved H sheets use selected date year; retries consume one ID
Null/invalid requests are rejected without consuming a number
Link copies journal details and memo fallback; final ID derives main Entry 42
Duplicate links and relinking to another entry are rejected
Settings customize prefix, classifications, meanings and year format
Editor save assigns confirmed ID and replaces tentative HTML
Editor amount mismatch blocks linking; large main IDs are never truncated
Corrections retain both IDs, require reason and enforce optimistic version
Linked corrections cannot contradict posted amount/currency
Unused sheet retains reference/history, never reuses number and cannot be linked
Non-admin RPC and table reads are denied
Snapshot and reset include vouchers/history and preserve settings/sequences
